recap.text: Katia Grim messages Carl to repair the blue shrine of Yemaya to remove the Crown of the Sepsis Whore. Bomo fits blue pieces together and reanimated daggers carry the Sun of Reawakening to an obelisk, causing Yemaya to re-ascend. Ogun calls Yemaya his sister and tells Carl to welcome her back. Yemaya rises from a fountain with neck gills and two tails, gives Princess Donut a mythical mystic card, and sends Bomo to Larracos.

Carl is banned from every temple except those where he is a friend of the church, including Yemaya's. Carl and Princess Donut freed Yemaya on the floor above. Eileithyia offers Katia a place in her court with Yemaya to keep her safe.

beats.headline: A name in a message
beats.text: Mid-fight in a temple of broken shrines, Katia Grim messages Carl and only Carl: do not touch the shrine you meant to repair. There is another nearby. A broken shrine of Yemaya. Her name is Yemaya. Remember that. It should be blue. Repair it, Katia writes, and it helps save both her and the cat, because the Crown of the Sepsis Whore is on her head and this is the only way off it on this floor. The chat window closes before she finishes the sentence.
beats.gist: Katia Grim messages Carl to repair a blue shrine of Yemaya to remove the Sepsis Whore's Crown.

beats.headline: The seventh shrine of seven
beats.text: The thorn room reads its terms aloud. Shrine seven: Yemaya, the river mother, who almost reached the Halls on her own and could not keep her power. Repair her and she ascends, gifts each squad a special card, and her friend Eileithyia grants each crawler a boon. Carl chooses her. Bomo fits five or six blue pieces together like Tetris, and reanimated daggers carry the Sun of Reawakening to the top of the obelisk. System message: the Goddess Yemaya has re-ascended, and is welcomed into the family by all.
beats.gist: Carl chooses Yemaya, Bomo fits blue pieces together, and reanimated daggers carry the Sun of Reawakening.

beats.headline: Ogun calls her his sister
beats.text: Ogun's charge against his two worshippers, stated calmly: they chased off Asojano, which might have saved them, but they also unleashed his sister back into the light, and that is unforgivable. The crawlers who actually built her shrine get only a warning to know their place. On his way out, having crushed one of those worshippers underfoot, the god gives Carl a message to deliver. Tell my sister I said, "Welcome back." Then he is gone in a shower of sparks.
beats.gist: Ogun crushes a worshipper and tells Carl to tell his sister, Yemaya, welcome back.

beats.headline: Out of the fountain
beats.text: Goddess of Rivers Yemaya. Level 250. Locked; unsponsored this season. Retainer of Eileithyia. Invulnerable on this floor, and standing in her own temple, which is worse. She rises out of the fountain: dark-skinned, pointed ears, neck gills, two tails curving up behind her to meet in a heart. Princess Donut identifies her as the Starbucks logo. Carl settles on siren. Her first remark is for the corpse on her floor: Ogun killed that man in her temple, and she means to do something about it.
beats.gist: Yemaya, the Level 250 Goddess of Rivers, rises out of a fountain in her temple.

beats.headline: Gifts, and a cretin sent away
beats.text: She thanks Bomo for her shrine. She tells Carl his slugpox is her brother's work, done on purpose, and a healer can fix it. She gives cards: one to Sister Ines, and to Princess Donut The Thief, a mythical mystic card that steals from an opponent's hand, with an invitation to worship at her altar. Then she asks Bomo what he desires. More games, he says. No. The Sledge; he misses his friend, who is in Larracos. It is done, she says, and Bomo is gone, along with the stairwell spell the party was counting on.
beats.gist: Yemaya thanks Bomo for her shrine and gives cards to Sister Ines and Princess Donut.

beats.headline: Whose retainer she is
beats.text: Mordecai supplies the file. This season a sponsored god may recruit a second, unsponsored one to help once the games begin on the twelfth floor. Eileithyia's retainer appears to be Yemaya, and her sponsor, Huanxin Jinx, needed a way to get her resurrected. Crawlers were the way, and Carl was the crawler. You just did that for her, Mordecai tells him, and that is why she says she is going to help you.
beats.gist: Mordecai tells Carl that he resurrected Yemaya for Huanxin Jinx, so Yemaya will help him.

beats.headline: Friend of the church
beats.text: Crawler Carl is banned from Club Vanquisher permanently, and from every temple except his own god's and those where he has been named a friend of the church. Yemaya's is on that list. That part is not a surprise to him: he and Princess Donut freed her on the floor above, and her mistress Eileithyia is on the list too. Some of the other names on it are a mystery to him.
beats.gist: Carl is banned from Club Vanquisher and most temples except those of his god and Yemaya.

beats.headline: Offered a place in her court
beats.text: Jamal, waiting outside a saferoom for a goddess, would very much like to see Eileithyia, and her retainer Yemaya, who he hears is the more beautiful. Carl says no. Eileithyia comes alone. Katia asks her for a pregnancy, and the goddess asks whether she is certain: come and assist her and Yemaya in her court instead, and she promises Katia is kept safe.
beats.gist: Jamal wants to see Yemaya, but Eileithyia comes alone and offers Katia a place in court.
